                           NEW YORK STATE SENATE





                                    THE

                            STENOGRAPHIC RECORD









                             ALBANY, NEW YORK

                               March 4, 1999

                                10:00 a.m.





                              REGULAR SESSION





                 SENATOR NANCY LARRAINE HOFFMANN, Acting
President

                 STEVEN M. BOGGESS, Secretary















                                                          784



                            P R O C E E D I N G S

                            ACTING PRESIDENT HOFFMANN:    The

                 Senate will come to order.

                            The Secretary will begin by reading

                 the Journal.

                            THE SECRETARY:    In Senate,

                 Wednesday, March 3, 1999.  The Senate met

                 pursuant to adjournment.  The Journal of

                 Tuesday, March 2 1999, was read and approved.

                 On motion, the Senate adjourned.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT HOFFMANN:    Hear

                 ing no objection, the Journal will stand

                 approved as read.

                            The order of business:

                            Presentation of petitions.

                            Messages from the Assembly.

                            Messages from the Governor.

                            Reports of standing committees.

                            Reports of select committees.

                            Communications and reports from

                 state officers.

                            Motions and resolutions.

                            Calendar.

                            Special orders.

                            Committee notices.





                                                          785



                            There being no further business to

                 come before the Senate, we'll stand adjourned.

                            (Whereupon, at 10:05 a.m., the

                 Senate adjourned.)
